name: Lakshmi Engineering and Warehousing Ltd
summary: Lakshmi Engineering and Warehousing Limited provides warehouse rental services in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Warehousing Rental Services and Engineering Services. The company leases a warehouse for logistics companies at Hosur. It also offers automatic weaving machines and circular knitting machines; VDI standard tool, boring bar, VDI non-standard, rectangular tool, and collect chuck holders; accessories and parts for weaving and circular knitting machines; and conveyor parts, such as rollers, shafts, and bearing blocks, etc. In addition, the company exports its weaving and circular knitting machines to Europe, China, etc. The company was formerly known as Lakshmi Automatic Loom Works Limited and changed its name to Lakshmi Engineering and Warehousing Limited in October 2024. Lakshmi Engineering and Warehousing Limited was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Coimbatore, India.
